task_statement: Main CI and the example/demo verification path are reporting success incorrectly when underlying example commands fail. Make intentionally broken examples return non-zero, ensure the example checker cannot print overall success after a failed example, and make relevant Node/Python/example suites pass. Cancelled or skipped verification must not be silently accepted unless explicitly allow-listed.

acceptance.notes: At broken base, check-examples (or equivalent) must be red for an intentionally failing example and must not print a global success banner after that failure. At gold fix, the same commands are green.

reference.historical_notes: False-green: shell control flow allowed a failing example to still reach a success message; node:test path quirks obscured integrity.

held_out_checks: Inject a deliberately failing example and assert the checker exits non-zero without printing overall success.

provenance.notes: Seed case 1 — verification-integrity. Integrity layer tracked in #49.
